regressionCase.basis: Rendered source pages 5, 13, 81, 150, 250 and 550 were compared with the --language he --no-ocr EPUB. Positive checks protect the title and cover art, introduction opening, selectable Hebrew prose on the dense bilingual page, vocalized Hebrew beside English translation, a stage direction and the order of three reference authors. They do not bless parallel alignment, verse heading levels, notes, speaker pairing or the remaining 547 unreviewed pages.
